title: SNU Fizzy Energy Nic Pouches by Bar Juice
description: SNU Fizzy Energy Nicotine Pouches deliver an intense and highly refreshing nicotine experience that is perfect for those seeking a dynamic, tobacco-free alternative. Created by Bar Juice 5000, known for their high-quality e-liquids, SNU brings premium nicotine quality with a nod to Swedish smokeless tobacco tradition. The Fizzy Energy flavour is light, juicy, and perfect for those who enjoy a refreshing twist, available in four nicotine strengths: 9mg, 12mg, 18mg, and an extra-strong 45mg, to match your preferred level. The Fizzy Energy flavour captures the unmistakable, tangy taste of a classic fruit-flavoured sports drink. It provides a sharp, sweet profile with a sparkling edge that tingles on the tastebuds, ensuring a consistently vibrant and lively taste from start to finish. Each pouch is soft, slim, and designed for discreet placement under the lip, ensuring a steady nicotine release without smoke, vapour, or odour. Ideal for any environment, SNU Fizzy Energy offers a clean, mess-free solution for nicotine enjoyment. The "scented can" allows you to rub the lid to release a hint of the vibrant fruit-flavoured sports drink aroma, giving a preview of the refreshing flavour within. SNU combines the heritage of Swedish pouch design with a tobacco-free formula, making Fizzy Energy a modern and convenient option for users. Nicotine Ranges: Low - 9mg this is best suited for new users Medium - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users High - 18mg this is suited for more experienced users Extra Strong - 45mg this is suited for more experienced users ONLY How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
